description: Promote graph staging to production. Creates a separate production Neo4j instance with its own credentials and database. Requires paid plan. A plan that drops data is refused, naming every table, field, entity or relationship it would drop, and every field whose type change rounds or cuts its values (a decimal with a smaller scale or turned integer, a datetime turned date): deploy_destructive applies it, a tool of its own so a client asks before it runs. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: deploy_graph_production
title: Deploy Graph to Production
